source_evidence: Exact player 'Great and the guardians would be free labor' establishes the Silverward-specific estate planning instruction that Rhevan, Ossric and their four skeletal sentries furnish voluntary unpaid House service including suitable ordinary labor as well as protection. Apply from their established service/actual eligible task windows, without inventing earlier work, wages or retconning expenses. Budget zero wages and ordinary food/rest costs for these six undead retainers, subject to actual equipment, tools, materials, maintenance and other genuine costs. Hessa may coordinate routine cleanup, debris clearance, carrying, drainage maintenance, basic repair assistance and similar suitable tasks within the guardians' accepted protective/restoration purpose and capabilities. The warders retain independent judgment and actual command of their skeletons. No automatic craft proficiency, unbounded output, forced labor against their motives, creation of new undead, simultaneous guard and labor assignment, daylight immunity or guaranteed construction success. Allocate work/guard coverage and realistic capacity, and retain qualified living tradespeople for specialist engineering/masonry and certification where needed. Apply this as an estate-specific planning/management ruling, not a new encounter or played workday. No new work, repair, cash transfer, wage accrual, title, funding, equipment purchase or game time established. Hessa remains paid5gp per actual workday from D332. Full estate registration/operational accounting remains pending. Current D333 western-road scene unchanged.
